title: tox [testenv:docs] fails due to missing dependencies
body:
<!--
  Hi there! Thank you for discovering and submitting an issue.

  Before you submit this, make sure that the issue doesn't already exist
  or if it is not closed.

  Is your issue fixed on the preview release?:
    pip install pylint astroid --pre -U
-->

### Steps to reproduce

1. Clone the repository
2. Create a new virtual environment
3. Install tox 
4. Run ``tox -e docs``

### Current behavior
The command fails with:
```
tox -e docs --recreate
docs recreate: /Users/andreas/programming/forks/pylint/.tox/docs
docs installdeps: -r/Users/andreas/programming/forks/pylint/requirements_docs.txt
docs installed: appdirs==1.4.4,distlib==0.3.1,filelock==3.0.12,packaging==20.9,pluggy==0.13.1,py==1.10.0,pylint==2.8.0.dev1,pyparsing==2.4.7,six==1.15.0,toml==0.10.2,tox==3.23.0,virtualenv==20.4.3
docs run-test-pre: PYTHONHASHSEED='3523030654'
docs run-test: commands[0] | sphinx-build -W -b html -d _build/doctrees . _build/html
Sphinx v3.5.3 in Verwendung

Configuration error:
There is a programmable error in your configuration file:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/Users/andreas/programming/forks/pylint/.tox/docs/lib/python3.8/site-packages/sphinx/config.py", line 327, in eval_config_file
    execfile_(filename, namespace)
  File "/Users/andreas/programming/forks/pylint/.tox/docs/lib/python3.8/site-packages/sphinx/util/pycompat.py", line 88, in execfile_
    exec(code, _globals)
  File "/Users/andreas/programming/forks/pylint/doc/conf.py", line 22, in <module>
    from pylint.__pkginfo__ import version
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pylint'

ERROR: InvocationError for command /Users/andreas/programming/forks/pylint/.tox/docs/bin/sphinx-build -W -b html -d _build/doctrees . _build/html (exited with code 2)
___________________________________ summary ____________________________________
ERROR:   docs: commands failed
```

### Expected behavior
Command succeeds and documentation is built.

### pylint --version output
No version output, since this is not an issue of the package itself.
Current commit in master branch: https://github.com/PyCQA/pylint/commit/f5e0968d6be95ae1bf9608e6bab6afcb8aa54663

I guess this was introduced with [this commit](https://github.com/PyCQA/pylint/commit/2e149d2ca8314ec7b4aaaa3b730a2b41bcf9b4a2#diff-ef2cef9f88b4fe09ca3082140e67f5ad34fb65fb6e228f119d3812261ae51449), which added as ``skipinstall = True`` for the docs testenv. Removing that line helps, as this will install all required dependencies.
